test_cases.title: Successfully add a single product to the cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
User is on the product catalog page
steps: Click the action to add the product to the shopping cart
Navigate to the shopping cart page
expected_result: The selected product is visible in the shopping cart

test_cases.title: Update cart badge when adding multiple products
preconditions: User is logged into the application
The shopping cart is currently empty
steps: Add the first product to the cart
Add a second different product to the cart
expected_result: The cart badge displays '1' after the first product is added
The cart badge displays '2' after the second product is added

test_cases.title: Navigate to checkout from the shopping cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
At least one product has been added to the shopping cart
steps: Click the button to proceed to checkout
expected_result: The user is redirected to the checkout interface
